references.text: The trumpets were used to sound the alarm when Israel went to war, just as Phinehas here carries the trumpets with him in the war against the Midianites.
Phinehas, son of Eleazar, showed his zeal for the Lord by killing an Israelite and a Midianite woman, and was therefore chosen to lead this war against the Midianites.
Moses commanded that a thousand men from each tribe be sent out to war against Midian, which is carried out in this verse.
Phinehas' lineage is mentioned here as son of Eleazar, son of Aaron, confirming his priestly descent.
Priests carried holy objects and blew trumpets during the war against Jericho, in a similar way that Phinehas carried the holy objects and trumpets.
Phinehas, son of Eleazar the priest, was later sent as leader of a delegation, showing his continued leadership role in Israel.
The priests blew trumpets when Israel went to war, as happened in the war against the Midianites.
